command:
cd /data && Rscript -e "df<-read.csv('preregSR_dataClean.csv'); cat('medicine k:',sum(df[['discipline']]=='Medicine (MEDI)', na.rm=TRUE),'
'); cat('n disclosed:',sum(as.numeric(df[['disclosedDenom']]), na.rm=TRUE),'
'); cat('k disclosed non-NA:',sum(!is.na(df[['disclosedNum']])), '
'); cat('sum meta n maybe:',sum(as.numeric(df[['disclosedDenom']][!is.na(df[['disclosedNum']])]), na.rm=TRUE),'
'); cat('nonmissing row count:',sum(!is.na(df[['disclosedDenom']]) & !is.na(df[['disclosedNum']])), '
');"
